title: Cryogenic Fuels Design Engineer, Rolls-Royce
short_description: Designed novel pumping technology for liquid hydrogen applications, including a high-precision test rig built for manufacture and assembly.
full_description: Placement-year work at Rolls-Royce designing novel pumping technology for liquid hydrogen fuel systems, using Siemens NX to develop a high-precision test rig from first concept through to a design ready for manufacture and assembly.
methodology: Used Siemens NX to design for manufacture and assembly of a high-precision test rig, supporting the development of novel pumping technology for liquid hydrogen applications.
